verdict.rationale: Manufact is a cloud hosting and gateway platform that stores deployments, logs and captured payloads, so region and data-residency choice is a fair axis. Nothing in the evidence pack documents selecting a storage region or residency location. The ability to downgrade a URL-connected server from the Manufact proxy to a direct external connection is a different control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
